fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 3, at db270e16a. Read the diff of 49149bb7a, abed08418 and db270e16a: parseCICauses and logBody in internal/api/ship.go, plus ship_test.go. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/api/ -run 'CICause|ShipInfraWait|Ship.*Cause|TestShipCheck': all pass, ok. That covers TestParseCICauses (gh-prefixed self-check log with fail render lines and 'make: *** [Makefile:186: self-check] Error 1' → a lint job/step finding quoting them; a fmt-check listing; a vet 'x.go:12:3:' diagnostic; a bare 'make: *** [build] Error 2' with the lines before it; apt 'Temporary failure resolving' and billing logs → none), TestShipCheckCIFindingsNonTest (fake gh: ci_findings recorded, --test-failures exit 0 on a cause and 1 on the infra log), TestShipInfraWaitSettlesOnCause (--settled --changed --rerun-infra settles on an attempt with a cause) and TestParseCICausesSkipsTestOutput (indented testscript output quoting 'fail render', a vet diagnostic or 'unformatted files:' yields no cause; the test is still found). This confirms cycle-2 quality f1 is fixed. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden: ok. Every internal/api test passed (PASS) in the full go test -trimpath ./internal/api/..., but the package exited FAIL because rootguard reported '.rhiza-root/usage.live.json: file changed'. That file is rewritten continuously by live Claude Code status lines (internal/adapter/claudecode/statusline.go) and is not in rootguard's owned list. This leaf does not touch it, so it is a pre-existing guard gap unrelated to this leaf. Model f1 fixed: the ship-change-ci-fix-step, ship-check-ci-test-findings and ci-triage-infra-waits statements now say a recognised non-test cause passes ci-triage and goes to ci-fix.
